picks.title: General Intuition's $2.3B bet that video games can train AI agents for the real world
picks.why_it_matters: A $320M raise at a $2.3B valuation signals massive investor appetite for novel AI training approaches, and validates gaming data as a legitimate path to embodied AI—opening a new category for early-stage startups to explore.

picks.title: Patronus AI lands $50M to build 'digital worlds' that stress-test AI agents
picks.why_it_matters: As AI agents proliferate, the testing/evaluation layer becomes critical infrastructure—this raise from ex-Meta researchers confirms enterprise demand for agent reliability tools, a space still early enough for new entrants.

picks.title: Trump administration asks OpenAI to limit next model release over security concerns
picks.why_it_matters: Government intervention in frontier model releases signals emerging regulatory risk for AI startups and could reshape competitive dynamics by limiting which companies can deploy cutting-edge capabilities domestically.
